nonblockingFindings: Reconciliation stage table row 'F3 complete MC04 wrapper' lists only the F2 artifact, wrapper candidate, alignment and RP03 admission as inputs, while the register stage 'f3' also requires 'i2' and 'atomic-accept' and the ROADMAP graph has MC02 -> MC04. The register/graph are consistent with package dependencies; the prose table row should be aligned to name I2 explicitly.

Register gate RP02 uses status 'source-interface-blocked', which is outside the declared gate/stage vocabulary (specified-only, pending-review, blocked, complete). The JSON schema validates only stageAdmission, not the gates array, so this is not caught mechanically. Editorial: use 'blocked' with a reason field.

ROADMAP RP03 and MC08 text says 'GPT-6' / 'GPT-6 reviews' without the 'high' effort qualifier; the reconciliation gate-record section and register auditEfforts pin gpt-6-astra at high. Harmonize ROADMAP wording to the pinned effort.

report-stage-admission.schema.json does not constrain 'requires' items to declared stage IDs, does not enforce stage-id uniqueness across the array, and cannot express acyclicity. Resolvability and acyclicity were verified manually here; the dispatcher (declared unimplemented) must validate them at runtime.

Retained fixture-source-note assigns the IVC codec shim and constrained finalizer to 'F1' and gives verifier_gadget lines 1177–1197/1204–1220, whereas the reconciliation assigns implementation to F0a and cites 1177-1199. The note is older read-only source evidence and the reconciliation supersedes; record the supersession and reconcile line references when the note is next revised.

ROADMAP does not mention the local-commits-only publication policy; it is carried only by the register publicationPolicy and the raw assignment. The MC01 register integrationNote still references 'User-authorized GitHub consolidation', which is historical and superseded by moriarty-local-only-2026-09-07.md; a short note that no further GitHub actions are authorized would avoid misreading.

P1 passes only via the P1-IVC control on the P2 two-step PoseidonChain<1> fixture; that generator is capped at k<=17 with no automatic increase, and the original R3 IVC exhausted rows at k17. If P2 generation fails, P1 and P2 both become incomplete and F2/F3 remain blocked. The plan handles this correctly (stop, preserve evidence, revise hypothesis) but the F0 finalizer/recursive-wrapper fit estimate should explicitly cover the P2 fixture wrapper, not only the loan relation.
Register stage 'f3' lists 'f1' in requires redundantly (already transitive via 'f2'); harmless. Mermaid graph declares node labels for MC02/MC03 after first bare use; cosmetic.

The interface-blocked disposition at F0 no-go names MC04 as route owner and RP02 as the gate but does not name a single record owner for the disposition file (backend-decision.json). Recommend stating MC04 writes it under RP02.

Package status values 'pending-audit' (MC01) and 'interface-blocked' (MC04) are said to follow the charter vocabulary, but the charter (openspec/MORIARTY-COMPLETION-PROGRAM.md) is not in the packet, so vocabulary conformance is unverified.
